findings.title: Stress gate cannot see a 2x solve CPU regression outside the metered simulate seams
findings.claim: A synthetic exact 2x CPU regression of HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize that lies outside the simulate_step/simulate_trajectory_batch/simulate_dhw_step seams trips none of the gate's verdicts (work_over_verdict on both count channels, kernel_cost_over_verdict, scenario_verdict, global ratio) on any of 5 sweep scenarios, because the only solve-wide CPU check uses SCENARIO_BUDGET_FACTOR=3.0 > DETECTION_TARGET=2.0.

evidence.value: flagged_solve_arm=0 of 5 (solve CPU x2.015 median, range 1.89-2.21; counts 1.000x; kernel 0.91-1.09x)
evidence.machine: Apple Silicon macOS dev box B3, venv-ci python 3.14
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, three compute seats; flagged count is a verdict count, solve ratio provisional

perturbation.expected_direction: flagged_solve_arm 0 -> 5 (measured 5/5); null --factor 1.0 stays 0/5; positive control --arm kernel gives 5/5

findings.metric_definition: Number of 5 sweep scenarios where any stress.py verdict fires on a solve injected with exactly 2x CPU via cpu_scaler around HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize, baseline = clean solve of same scenario in same process.
